# Michael Romani Balloon Twisting

> Professional, fully insured balloon twisting entertainer serving Chicago, IL and nearby suburbs, with over 9 years of experience.

Michael Romani provides hourly balloon twisting entertainment for birthday parties, weddings, block parties, school events and carnivals, festivals, corporate events, and fundraisers. Guests choose from a custom balloon menu of balloon animals and sculptures, twisted on the spot.

Service area: Chicago Loop, Logan Square, Lincoln Square, and Evanston, IL have dedicated pages; Michael also serves Lake View, Lincoln Park, River North, the West Loop, the South Loop, Wicker Park, Uptown, Rogers Park, Edgewater, Andersonville, Old Irving Park, and other North Side and downtown neighborhoods, plus nearby suburbs including Skokie, Glenview, Wilmette, Northbrook, Morton Grove, and Winnetka.

Pricing is quote-based on event length, guest count, and location — there is no fixed price list. Contact for a free custom quote.

Contact: (812) 887-9056 · romanimike@gmail.com · Instagram @artmichaelromani
